column1: # THE run-shard.sh HALF OF THE FLOOR FIX, EXERCISED ON REAL WINDOWS.
# `grant-matrix.mjs` and `run-shard.sh` share the cell floor and each carries its own copy
# of it. The Windows floor had no `python`, no `python3` and no `git` while the POSIX floor
# gets all three free from `/usr/bin`; grant-matrix was fixed first, run-shard.sh — the
# harness behind every corpus survive/break number, including the Windows 41.7% figure —
# was not. A fix nothing exercises is a fix nobody knows about, so this shard exists purely
# to drive the repaired floor and let the job assert its `study_path_tool_run=` lines.
# THREE BARE node-gyp COMPILES, the same positive controls the ladder shards lead with.
# node-gyp is what needs Python, so a shard of anything else would run green on a floor
# that still had none. Versions pinned: a control whose meaning drifts with a new release
